# Custom Java Instrumentation Agent Demo
## (Generated by ChatGPT)

Requirements:
- JDK 21
- Gradle 8.x

## Build

```bash
gradle clean build
```

Artifacts:

```text
custom-agent/build/libs/custom-agent-1.0.0.jar
demo-app/build/libs/demo-app-1.0.0.jar
```

## Run with agent

```bash
java \
  -javaagent:custom-agent/build/libs/custom-agent-1.0.0.jar \
  -jar demo-app/build/libs/demo-app-1.0.0.jar
```

## Test annotated method

```bash
curl "http://localhost:8085/api/orders/data?x=10&y=20&mainValue=ABC"
```

Expected response:

```text
ABC-30
```

Expected agent log resembles:

```text
This is the custom agent in method: OrderService.getData at time: ..., the parameters: [10, 20, ABC], return value: ABC-30
```

## Test primitive return

```bash
curl "http://localhost:8085/api/orders/calculate?price=200&quantity=3"
```

Expected agent log includes `return value: 600`.

## Test void return

```bash
curl "http://localhost:8085/api/orders/notify?orderId=100"
```

Expected agent log includes `return value: <void>`.

## Verify method without annotation is ignored

```bash
curl "http://localhost:8085/api/orders/plain?value=ABC"
```

Response:

```text
NO-AGENT-LOG-ABC
```

There should be no custom-agent method log for `OrderService.methodWithoutAnnotation`.

## Disable custom agent logging

Set:

```yaml
custom:
  agent:
    enabled: false
```

or remove `custom.agent.enabled` entirely. The Spring property defaults to `false`.

Important: because `@Value` is resolved after JVM startup, the agent still installs its bytecode transformations. When disabled, injected Advice immediately returns and emits no method log.
